meaning: Earliest intended useful processing/extraction unlock. It does NOT gate worldgen, ore mining, JEI, or game progression.
mining_policy: All registered ore blocks currently self-drop with a stone-tier pickaxe baseline. Do not impose metal-tool gating that would softlock the first iron bloom; revisit only with tested metal tool progression.
quality_policy: Preserve current copper/tin/bronze recipes and the already agreed quality concept. No new grade math or low-grade ingot substitution without a separate decision.

ages.purpose: Basic ceramic feed and low-grade fuel; no production recipe is active yet.
Copper and Tin concentrates, plus quartz via Grinder → Washer → Sifter.
Iron-mineral preparation for the Bloomery; Lead is an optional early byproduct chain, not a bloom requirement.
Carbon processing, high-grade fuels, Zinc/Brass and precious metals.
Steel alloy additions, Chromium, Nickel and recovered industrial diamonds.
Bulk chemical feedstocks, fertilizer materials and controlled Mercury processing.
Liquid hydrocarbons, petroleum refining and lubrication; no new mandatory ore deposit.
Electric metallurgy, Aluminum and Silicon, specialty metals and electronics.
Fuel-cycle metallurgy and endgame advanced materials.
